name: AdFind
description: AdFind is a free command-line query tool that can be used for gathering information from Active Directory.
classification_note: Included because the active pinned ATT&CK object has type tool. This is an upstream classification, not an assurance of benignness or a recommendation to run it.
guide_currentness: Historical guides retain publication dates. Commands and product availability have not been revalidated.

evidence.description: AdFind can extract subnet information from Active Directory.
